basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old from Vancouver, Canada, currently in my gap year before heading to college. I've been a gamer since I was a kid, with a particular love for challenging titles like Demon's Souls. When I'm not gaming, you can find me listening to EDM or exploring new riddims. I work part-time at a local coffee shop, which gives me flexible hours to game and browse Reddit late into the night. I'm single and enjoying the freedom to connect with people online who share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have no formal education in game mechanics but have learned a lot from countless hours of gameplay and watching YouTube guides. I also pick up tips from Reddit threads and gaming forums.
